stories.headline: 70+ dogs rescued from a farm months before Korea's ban
stories.summary: Humane World for Animals Korea took in the last 70+ dogs at a farm that once held up to 1,000. They go to shelters in the US and Canada to be adopted. A full ban on dog meat starts in 2027.
stories.why: The group calls it likely its last big rescue as the industry ends.

stories.headline: Gene therapy partly restored sight in blind patients
stories.summary: One eye injection made surviving retina cells sensitive to light, and special goggles feed them images. In a 10-person trial, 6 had meaningful gains, and some could find a door or touch a notebook.
stories.why: It works no matter which gene caused the blindness.

stories.stat_label: new islands built from river sand
stories.headline: River sand became 7 new wildlife islands on the Mississippi
stories.summary: Engineers used 500,000 cubic yards of sand dredged from the river channel to build 7 islands in McGregor Lake, and planted them to grow forest for eagles, herons and songbirds.
stories.why: Sand that had to be dredged anyway now shelters fish and birds.
stories.image_credit: U.S. National Archives / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain

stories.stat_label: types of dishes on one ship
stories.headline: A 2,100-year-old shipwreck held thousands of intact dishes
stories.summary: Divers off Turkey found a Rome-bound cargo ship carrying thousands of plates and bowls in 122 styles, packed in clay inside crates. They likely came from Rhosus, a town Cicero ordered dishes from.
stories.why: Careful ancient packing kept the cargo safe for over 2,000 years.

fun_fact: Cicero wrote about ordering dishes from Rhosus in a letter around 50 BCE.
